title: Pointer to the properties of [def-pod-perfect-complex-on-x]
text:
In the notation of [def-pod-perfect-complex-on-x], the following holds. The
coefficient dual $K^\vee$ and the evaluation of
[def-pod-coefficient-dual-on-x] are formed with the
derived internal Hom;
the flatness, finite Tor-amplitude and constructibility of the local
finite projective model are [prop-pod-perfect-local-model].
